description: List the org's sobjects (API name and label). No parameters.
embedding_description: List every Salesforce object visible to the authenticated user, standard and custom alike, with their API names. The discovery step before querying or describing a particular object, for when you need to know what the org actually contains.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with sobjects: a list of {name, label} objects.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: List the object names and labels plainly; low sensitivity (metadata only, data_sensitivity 0.1).

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.auth_failed: the sf CLI has no live session for the registered org. sf.api_error: an unexpected org error.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: sf.auth_failed: ask the operator to re-establish the org session with: sf org login web.
